messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off a 24h soak in staging to validate the new leaky-bucket burst controls. Focus: per-key burst windows (5s, 30s) vs per-org hard caps. Can someone pair on dashboards tomorrow morning?

devin: I can monitor. what's the traffic mix? mobile vs server-to-server?

maria: ~60% mobile (short requests, lots of small payloads), 30% web, 10% bulk batch. We'll replay traces from last month's traffic and inject synthetic spikes.

sanjay: Important: ensure we test both enforcement modes. I saw a discrepancy in the staging proxy where per-key tokens were consumed but rl_drop_rate stayed 0. Might be a metrics emission bug.

rithvik: +1 on metrics. Add these to the watchlist: `rate_limit.enforced_count`, `rate_limit.dropped_count`, `rate_limit.burst_tokens`, `quota.used_tokens`, and `rl.latency_p95`. Also check `ingress.throttle_reasons` tag.

louise: Can we run a paired run that flips the config between leaky-bucket and token-bucket so we compare side-by-side? I can script it.

maria: yes — plan: two 12h windows back-to-back. first window leaky-bucket (burst=30, refill=6/s), second window token-bucket equivalent. We'll keep same synthetic input.

devin: I'll deploy the replay job. Using k6 for the synthetic traffic. Sample command: `k6 run --vus 200 --duration 12h replay.js --out influxdb=http://staging-metrics:8086`

devin: replay.js will mimic session stickiness + API keys. I'll tag traces with `test_id:leaky-vs-token-1779` so Grafana can filter.

maria: sweet — add `x-test-run:leaky-vs-token-1779` header on all requests so traces collapse cleanly.

sanjay: If you see a client spike producing 429s but `rate_limit.dropped_count` is low, check the edge proxy logs. We had a bug where the enforcement counter increments only on full-drop, not on negotiated-slowdown.

rithvik: Logging snippet we used last time: ```json
{"ts":"$NOW","component":"edge-proxy","msg":"rate_limit_event","key":"api_key_123","action":"delay","delay_ms":120}
```

louise: I'll add an alert rule to the staging Grafana: if `rate_limit.enforced_count` > 100/min and `rl_drop_rate` > 0.05 for >5m, ping #eng-oncall and pager. Keep it non-prod but visible.

devin: Heads-up: we should also validate per-org aggregated counters. Some tests will hammer multiple keys belonging to same org; per-org quota should cap aggregate throughput. I will create a scenario that rotates 50 keys under a single org id.

maria: Good. Also want to validate console UX: when quota is hit we should see the rollout UX entry in the Console -> Routes -> Rate limits with the active policy id. Can someone confirm the policy id surface shows on the error trace?

rithvik: It surfaces as `applied_policy_id` in traces, yes. But UI might still show stale cache for 30s. That's expected — TTL on policy cache is 30s in staging.

devin: Deploy-bot: deploying replay job and metric exporters now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment started for `k6-replay-leaky-vs-token-1779` to staging. CI checks passed. ETA ~2m.

maria: After the two windows, we need a short regression check: compare `cost_per_1k_tokens` approximated from `quota.used_tokens` and `inference.tokens_generated`. If leaky-bucket reduces tail latency but increases cost significantly, we may tune refill rate.

louise: I'll prepare a small notebook to compute token-cost and p95 latency delta automatically.

sanjay: Minor note — remember to disable autoscaling interference on the Dedicated staging pool during the test, otherwise elastics will distort latency. @devops (cc) — please freeze autoscale for 6h.

maria: Thanks all. Timeline: start 04/02 02:00 UTC first window, switch without downtime at 14:00 UTC to second window. Please be available for the first hour. I'll post result summary in this thread. :thumbsup:

devin: I'll be on watch. linking dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/platform-rate-limits?orgId=1&var-test=leaky-vs-token-1779 :eyes:

rithvik: If anyone sees weird redis token-bucket drift, open a short incident and tag me.

maria: Great — thanks. If we hit unexpected behavior we'll pause and triage.

louise: :thumbsup:
